'''Corellian scavenge rats''', also known as '''scavenger rats''', were [[Rodent/Legends|rodents]] native to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].

{{Creature-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Scavenger rats appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
